observed_reality: Current-main lineage composition executes successfully but explicitly leaves external-anchor trust unverified, exact lineage-plus-anchor clone safety false, production integration false, and accepted Hostinger proof false.

The existing freshness bridge itself states that an exact clone or rollback of both lineage admission and external anchor requires a trusted out-of-snapshot freshness authority or equivalent remotely or physically monotonic witness.
State-local content identity therefore cannot close the exact-clone freshness failure domain by itself.

macrocycle_unusual_experiment.name: IDENTICAL_CLONE_EXTERNAL_CAS_RACE_V1
macrocycle_unusual_experiment.scope: disposable GitHub branch object only; no product/canonical Frank state
macrocycle_unusual_experiment.result: one of two identical stale-SHA writers advanced the external witness; the second stale writer was rejected; disposable file was removed afterward

primary_external_evidence: GitHub Contents API requires the current blob SHA when updating a file and documents HTTP 409 Conflict.

etcd v3.6 transactions are atomic If/Then/Else operations whose guards can compare value, version, create_revision or mod_revision and are explicitly suitable for compare-and-swap and concurrency control.
etcd exposes cluster_id plus cluster-wide monotonically increasing store revision; normal Range reads are linearizable unless serializable mode is explicitly requested.

generated_realities.hypothesis: An out-of-snapshot compare-and-swap witness can discriminate identical stale clones at one acquisition transition.
generated_realities.strongest_counter_reality: The losing clone may later observe the successor and attempt reacquisition, so one CAS transition alone does not provide durable singleton/effect safety.

generated_realities.hypothesis: A remote linearizable CAS plus monotonic fencing generation can close rollback/dual-holder ambiguity if every authoritative state/effect boundary validates the generation.
generated_realities.strongest_counter_reality: Lease expiry, backend restore/identity swap, crash between remote acquisition and local persistence, or failure to carry fencing to an actual commit boundary can still admit stale effects.

generated_realities.hypothesis: GitHub Contents CAS itself should become production freshness authority.
generated_realities.strongest_counter_reality: The experiment proves stale-update exclusion only; it does not prove production-grade lease/fencing semantics, availability, latency, backend continuity, or non-bypassable composition with every Frank state/effect commit.

architecture_delta.summary: Require a remote freshness authority outside the Hostinger snapshot failure domain with linearizable predecessor-CAS and a monotonically ordered fencing token. Lease/TTL may provide liveness, but stale generations must be rejected at authoritative UnifiedDB, selected-lineage, execution-lease and consequential effect commit/reentry boundaries.
architecture_delta.rollback: No product code changed; remove/close candidate if ordinary differential tests show no benefit or unacceptable dependency/cost.
